arxiv-2109-11200.title: Secure PAC Bayesian Regression via Real Shamir Secret Sharing
arxiv-2109-11200.creator: Jaron Skovsted Gundersen, Bulut Kuskonmaz, Rafael Wisniewski
arxiv-2109-11200.description: Abstract A common approach of system identification and machine learning is to generate a model by using training data to predict the test data instances as accurately as possible. Nonetheless, concerns about data privacy are increasingly raised, but not always addressed.

arxiv-2211-08567.title: Quantum Reservoir Computing Implementations for Classical and Quantum Problems
arxiv-2211-08567.creator: Adam Burgess, Marian Florescu
arxiv-2211-08567.description: Abstract In this article we employ a model open quantum system consisting of two-level atomic systems coupled to Lorentzian photonic cavities, as an instantiation of a quantum physical reservoir computer. We then deployed the quantum reservoir computing approach to an archetypal machine learning problem of image recognition.

arxiv-2212-10882.title: Group-size dependent synergy in heterogeneous populations Journal: Chaos Solitons and Fractals
arxiv-2212-10882.creator: Hsuan-Wei Lee, Colin Cleveland, and Attila Szolnoki
arxiv-2212-10882.description: Abstract When people collaborate, they expect more in return than a simple sum of their efforts. This observation is at the heart of the so-called public goods game, where the participants’ contributions are multiplied by an r r synergy factor before they are distributed among group members.

arxiv-2302-08401.title: LinSets.zip: Compressing Linear Set Diagrams
arxiv-2302-08401.creator: Markus Wallinger, Alexander Dobler, and Martin Nöllenburg
arxiv-2302-08401.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Markus Wallinger, Alexander Dobler, and Martin Nöllenburg. Linear diagrams are used to visualize set systems by depicting set memberships as horizontal line segments in a matrix, where each set is represented as a row and each element as a column. Each such line segment of a set is shown in a contiguous horizontal range of cells of the matrix indicating that the corresponding elements in the columns belong to the set.

arxiv-2405-11256.title: On the Euler function of linearly recurrent sequences
arxiv-2405-11256.creator: Florian Luca, Makoko Campbell Manape
arxiv-2405-11256.description: Abstract In this paper, we show that if ( U n ) n ≥ 1 (U_{n})_{n\geq 1} is any nondegenerate linearly recurrent sequence of integers whose general term is up to sign not a polynomial in n n , then the inequality ϕ ⁡ ( | U n | ) ≥ | U ϕ ⁡ ( n ) | \phi(|U_{n}|)\geq|U_{\phi(n)}|

arxiv-2509-05995.title: Students’ Perceptions of the Use of LLMs in Requirements Engineering Education: A Cross-University Empirical Study
arxiv-2509-05995.creator: 1 st Sharon Guardado, 2 nd Risha Parveen, 3 rd Zheying Zhang, 4 th Maruf Rayhan, 5 th Nirnaya Tripathi
arxiv-2509-05995.description: Abstract The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Requirements Engineering (RE) education is reshaping pedagogical approaches, seeking to enhance student engagement and motivation while providing practical tools to support their professional future. This study empirically evaluates the impact of integrating LLMs in RE coursework.

arxiv-2510-06725.title: Continuous measurement-based holonomic quantum computation
arxiv-2510-06725.creator: Anirudh Lanka, Juan Garcia-Nila, Todd A. Brun
arxiv-2510-06725.description: Abstract We propose a scheme to generate holonomies using the Quantum Zeno effect, enabling logical unitary operations on quantum stabilizer codes purely through measurements. The quantum error-correcting code space is adiabatically rotated by measuring a succession of rotated stabilizer generators.

pmc-10636616.creator: Xulin Yang, Hang Qiu, Liya Wang, Xiaodong Wang
pmc-10636616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundMachine learning (ML) methods have shown great potential in predicting colorectal cancer (CRC) survival. However, the ML models introduced thus far have mainly focused on binary outcomes and have not considered the time-to-event nature of this type of modeling.ObjectiveThis study aims to evaluate the performance of ML approaches for modeling time-to-event survival data and develop transparent models for predicting CRC-specific survival.MethodsThe data set used in this retrospective cohort study contains information on patients who were newly diagnosed with CRC between December 28,

pmc-10650663.title: Reduction in Arterial Stiffness Index (SI) in Response to Combination Antioxidant Therapy
pmc-10650663.creator: Laurence Guy Howes, Tanya Unni, Ameer Hamza, Jan B. Howes, Rohan Jayasinghe
pmc-10650663.description: Antioxidants reduce arterial stiffness, but the effects previously reported are weak. A systematic review of the antioxidants vitamin E, vitamin C, vitamin A, and beta-carotenes (the most commonly studied antioxidants) on pulse wave velocity (PWV) found an effect size of only −0.20 (approximately −16 m/s or −2.5%).

pmc-11353523.title: A Hierarchical Multi-Task Learning Framework for Semantic Annotation in Tabular Data
pmc-11353523.creator: Jie Wu, Mengshu Hou, Ernestina Menasalvas
pmc-11353523.description: To optimize the utilization and analysis of tables, it is essential to recognize and understand their semantics comprehensively. This requirement is especially critical given that many tables lack explicit annotations, necessitating the identification of column types and inter-column relationships. Such identification can significantly augment data quality, streamline data integration, and support data analysis and mining.

pmc-11482609.title: High-resolution reconstruction of a C. elegans ribosome sheds light on evolutionary dynamics and tissue specificity
pmc-11482609.creator: Enisha Sehgal, Chloe Wohlenberg, Evan M Soukup, Marcus J Viscardi, Vitor Hugo Balasco Serrão, Joshua A Arribere
pmc-11482609.description: Caenorhabditis elegans is an important model organism for human health and disease, with foundational contributions to the understanding of gene expression and tissue patterning in animals. An invaluable tool in modern gene expression research is the presence of a high-resolution ribosome structure, though no such structure exists for C. elegans.

pmc-11590476.title: Nicotinamide mononucleotide improves the ovarian reserve of POI by inhibiting NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis of ovarian granulosa cells
pmc-11590476.creator: Yue Ma, Weihua Nong, Ou Zhong, Ke Liu, Siyuan Lei, Chen Wang, Xi Chen, Xiaocan Lei
pmc-11590476.description: BackgroundPremature ovarian insufficiency (POI) is a common clinical problem, but there is currently no effective treatment. NLRP3 inflammasome-induced pyroptosis is thought to be a possible mechanism of POI. Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) has a certain anti-inflammatory effect, providing a promising approach for the treatment of POI.

pmc-11612268.title: Impact of tortuosity of the V1-segment vertebral artery on mechanical thrombectomy
pmc-11612268.creator: Zhoucheng Kang, Hanghang Zhao, Dong Wei, Yang Li, Rui Shi, Li Li
pmc-11612268.description: Tortuosity of the vasculature poses challenges to mechanical thrombectomy (MT); however, only a few studies have reported the impact of vertebral artery (VA) tortuosity on MT. The present study aimed to investigate the impact of tortuosity of the V1-segment VA on MT in patients with acute vertebrobasilar artery occlusion (AVBAO).

pmc-12503677.title: A 39-year-old man with a rectal pumpkin seed bezoar
pmc-12503677.creator: Alisha Hussey, Brendan Lee, Matthew Douglas-Vail
pmc-12503677.description: tum, where they can cause substantial pain and impaction. Although a rectal seed bezoar is diagnosed clinically, sonography is more reliable than plain abdominal radiography for distinguishing rectal seed bezoars from fecal impaction, and computed tomography remains the most accurate means of characterizing bezoars and detecting complications such as obstruction or perforation.

pmc-12557939.title: Targeting PP2A in cancer: an underrated option
pmc-12557939.creator: Fabio Sarais, Finja Krempien, Caroline Koehn, Lara Brewing, Carl Friedrich Classen, Michael Walter, Olia Shokraie
pmc-12557939.description: Protein phosphatase 2A plays a central role in modulating multiple signaling pathways, including PI3K, EGFR, Myc, WNT, JAK/STAT, RAS/MAPK, and NF-κB, which are frequently dysregulated in cancer. Although PP2A is broadly considered a tumor suppressor due to its frequent functional loss in tumors, its biological role is highly context-dependent and varies across cancer types and stages.

pmc-12640475.title: Reconstructing the evolutionary history of herbaceous crops through trait‐based ecology
pmc-12640475.creator: Alicia Gómez‐Fernández
pmc-12640475.description: Reconstructing the evolution of crop plants is fundamental to understanding their origins, ecological adaptations, and impacts on ecosystem processes. However, our understanding of crop evolution stems largely from archaeology and genetics, with less focus on a trait‐based ecological approach. Crop‐specific studies have shown that phenotypic traits changed substantially during domestication and modern breeding.

pmc-13077896.title: Identification of the BAHD gene family in Korla fragrant pear and functional characterization of PsBAHD6 in resistance to pear Valsa canker
pmc-13077896.creator: Wang Lanfei, Yu Mingyang, Jia Yuanyuan, Wang Hao, Zhao Keke, Liu Can, Fan Weifan, Li Xin, Zeng Junkai, Wu Xiao, Zhang Shaoling, Bao Jianping
pmc-13077896.description: This study performed genome-wide identification and functional characterization of BAHD genes in Korla fragrant pear and investigated their roles in the defense response against Valsa canker. A total of 42 PsBAHD members were identified. Evolutionary and collinearity analyses indicated that this gene family is evolutionarily conserved across Rosaceae species and has been subjected to strong purifying selection.

pmc-13337699.title: Jujuboside A extends healthspan and enhances resistance of oxidative stress in Caenorhabditis elegans via the transcription factor DAF-16/FOXO3A and SKN-1/Nrf2
pmc-13337699.creator: Yunliang Cao, Shuangjie Ren, Xiaocong Li, Xin Xiao, Yi Xiao

pmc-13462317.title: Dose-dependent effects of radiotherapy on body composition, nutritional status, and clinical symptoms in head and neck cancer
pmc-13462317.creator: Meltem Öztürk İyilikci, Derya Hopancı Bıçaklı, Özlem Özkaya Akagündüz, Beril Balcı Topuz, Mustafa Esassolak
pmc-13462317.description: Radiotherapy (RT) and chemoradiotherapy (CRT) for head and neck cancer (HNC) frequently result in significant malnutrition, muscle wasting, and systemic inflammation, which can compromise treatment tolerance and clinical outcomes. This study aimed to evaluate the dose–volume effects of RT, symptom burden, and treatment modality on nutritional status, body composition, and inflammatory markers in HNC patients.

pmc-13473669.title: LiMPtTl (M = Ti, Zr) Heusler alloys for high-performance energy harvesting: a DFT study
pmc-13473669.creator: Ramesh Sharma, Ali B M Ali, Jisha Annie Abraham, Jaya Madan, Nikhil Shrivastav, Sabirov Sardor, Mirjalol Ismoilov, F F Al-Harbi, Awatif Alshamari
pmc-13473669.description: The current study explores the electronic, thermodynamic, elastic, optical, and thermoelectric properties of the quaternary Heusler alloys LiMPtTl (M = Ti, Zr) using the full-potential linearized augmented plane wave method within the framework of density functional theory, along with semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory. Band structure and density of states calculations indicate semiconducting behavior with indirect band gaps of 0.

pmc-13517462.title: Ochratoxin A Toxicity Research in In Vitro and In Vivo Experimental Settings: A Cross-Software Bibliometric and Science-Mapping Study
pmc-13517462.creator: José Manuel Veiga-del-Baño, José Oliva, Pedro Andreo-Martínez, Miguel Motas, Eva María Mateo, José Miguel Soria, María Ángeles García-Esparza
pmc-13517462.description: Background: Ochratoxin A (OTA) is a widespread mycotoxin with well-established nephrotoxic, immunotoxic, and carcinogenic properties. Despite decades of research, the structure, thematic evolution, and emerging directions of the scientific literature on OTA toxicity remain incompletely mapped. Methods: A bibliometric analysis was conducted using 883 publications indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection (1965–2025).

pmc-13520293.title: Identification of depression types and key influencing factors among rural elderly in China: a comprehensive analysis based on machine learning and network analysis
pmc-13520293.creator: Bo Dong, Li Wang, Yifan Li

pmc-13548471.title: Assessing pediatricians’ readiness for artificial intelligence: a cross-sectional study in Istanbul, Türki̇ye
pmc-13548471.creator: Eren Güzeloğlu, Belen Ateş, Feyza Aydin Özgür, Sevi̇lay Kök, Hüseyi̇n Dağ, Vefi̇k Arica
pmc-13548471.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into healthcare, including pediatrics, offering new opportunities for diagnosis, management, and decision support. However, the effective implementation of AI depends largely on healthcare professionals’ knowledge, attitudes, and readiness to adopt these technologies. This study aimed to evaluate pediatricians’ general attitudes toward artificial intelligence and their level of readiness for medical AI in Istanbul, Türkiye at tertiary hospital.

pmc-13555608.title: Tropilaelaps mercedesae: an emerging global threat to apiculture – a comprehensive review
pmc-13555608.creator: Mojtaba Esmaeily, Sunho Kwon, Esmaeil Babaeian, Chuleui Jung
pmc-13555608.description: Honey bees (Apis spp.) are key pollinators in agricultural and natural ecosystems; however, their populations are declining due to multiple interacting stressors and their synergistic effects, including parasitic mites. While Varroa destructor is widely recognized as the primary global driver of colony losses, mites of the genus Tropilaelaps, particularly Tropilaelaps mercedesae, are emerging as a serious and still underestimated threat.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Permanent ineligibility Notwithstanding the provisions of section 405(b) 1 but subject to subsection (c), any alien who applies or has applied for exemption or discharge from training or service in the Armed Forces.
